systems.country_label: Serviço de Pagamentos ao Estado (SESPE), part of the e-SISTAFE revenue collection module
systems.tiers: collects taxes and fees for central bodies, provincial and district decentralised governance bodies and municipalities, routed to the Conta Autárquica for municipal revenue

note: An excerpt of the finance minister's November 2025 address: SESPE links e-SISTAFE to commercial banks and e-money institutions so that payers can pay electronically what is owed to state bodies, districts and municipalities. It is a payment channel for the public; the speech does not say municipal or district offices are connected or work in the system, so no fact is recorded.
